Name: Emily Sprite Edit
Author: lakoria
Description:
[center][size=2][font=Verdana]There's about a million different mods available that already do this, but their changes are a bit too drastic for me. I know Emily's 1800s nightgown is hard to work with, but I didn't want her to just have a completely new body, so I decided to do something for my own personal use. She now has an off the shoulder dress with a belt, and her general sprite shape has (mostly) remained intact! I didn't really know what to do with her feet without changing the skirt so they animate a little weirdly. ¯\_(ツ)_/¯ I also made minor changes to her hair so that it matches her portrait a bit better.

I've only been able to test her walking/standing/kissing sprites in my own game, I'd appreciate if anyone who uses this lets me know if any of the other sprites look wonky! I struggled to color over some of them without completely redrawing her, some of those sprites are... weirdly shaped.[/font][/size][/center]

[/list]
